name: Snap Booth
summary: A retro photo booth that counts down, snaps your camera (or a sample visitor), develops the print and uploads
about: Snap Booth is a camera upload dressed as a fairground booth with chasing bulbs and velvet curtains. The camera starts only when you press Camera; until then a cartoon visitor waves in the viewfinder. Pick a filter, press the red button and a 3, 2, 1 timer runs before the shutter closes, the flash fires and a real JPEG develops on a white print, which you can retake, save or upload into the film strip.
how: Press Camera to use your webcam (or Use a photo to pick a picture or open the phone camera).
Choose Natural, Mono, Warm or Pop.
Press the red button: 3, 2, 1, flash, and the print develops with its real size.
Retake, Save the JPEG, or Upload it into the film strip.
